title: In accordance with the provisions of Outside Section 146 of Chapter 150 of the Acts of 1990. The Commission of the Department of Public Utilities hereby makes an assessment of $250,000 against the owners of certain electric utilities. This assessment is to fund the Fiscal Year 1992 activities of the "Out of State Nuclear Safety Program" for the Department of Public Safety.
filings: Memorandum from J. Stetson, Hearing Officer. RE: Closure of Docket.
